issues.jp_before: 夏休[なつやす]みに小[ちい]さな{島[しま]|nt-n4-a}へ行[い]きました。
issues.problem: English 'in the summer vacation' is unidiomatic.
issues.action: English changed to 'during the summer vacation'.

issues.jp_before: 冬[ふゆ]は{厚[あつ]い|nt-homophone}コートが必要[ひつよう]です。
issues.problem: Distractor 圧い is not a word; a homophone item should use real あつい words.
issues.action: Replaced 圧い with 篤い.

issues.jp_before: 夏[なつ]の午後[ごご]は{暑[あつ]い|nt-homophone}ですね。
issues.problem: Distractor 圧い is not a word.
issues.action: Replaced 圧い with 篤い.

issues.jp_before: {熱[あつ]い|nt-homophone}お茶[ちゃ]で、舌[した]をやけどしました。
issues.problem: Distractor 圧い is not a word.
issues.action: Replaced 圧い with 篤い.

issues.jp_before: この部屋[へや]は暖[あたた]かくて、とても{快適[かいてき]|nt-n3-a}です。
issues.problem: Distractor 快商 uses 商, which does not look like 適 and is not a real look-alike.
issues.action: Replaced 快商 with 快摘.

issues.jp_before: {午後[ごご]|nt-n4-a}は雨[あめ]が降[ふ]るそうです。
issues.problem: 'why' had the stroke difference reversed: it is 牛, not 午, whose vertical stroke goes through the top.
issues.action: why rewritten: '午 has no stroke poking through the top, unlike 牛.'

issues.jp_before: ジュースを冷蔵庫[れいぞうこ]で{冷[ひ]やし|nt-okurigana}ます。
issues.problem: The only distractor, 冷し, is an officially allowed okurigana variant (許容; compare 冷し中華), so it is not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced the item with a new okurigana item: 姉は小学校で英語を{教えて}います, distractors 教[お]しえて / 教[おしえ]て.

issues.jp_before: 毎晩[まいばん]、七時[しちじ]に家[いえ]へ{帰[かえ]り|nt-homophone}ます。
issues.problem: Distractor 飼 has no かえ reading and is not a homophone or a look-alike.
issues.action: Replaced 飼り with the homophone 替り.

issues.jp_before: {右[みぎ]|nt-n5}の手[て]に傘[かさ]を持[も]っています。
issues.problem: 右の手 sounds unnatural; the normal word is 右手.
issues.action: Rewrote the sentence as {右手[みぎて]}に傘を持っています and changed the distractors to 石手/古手/左手.

issues.jp_before: このカレーは{辛[から]い|nt-n3-b}ので、水[みず]が必要[ひつよう]です。
この町[まち]の{特徴[とくちょう]|nt-n3-b}は、古[ふる]い橋[はし]です。
issues.problem: 'why' described the 徴/微 difference inaccurately ('王 and a bar').
issues.action: why rewritten: '徴 has 王 under the 山 in the middle, where 微 has 几.'

issues.jp_before: {細[こま]かい|nt-okurigana}字[じ]は、読[よ]めません。
issues.problem: English 'such' is not in the Japanese.
issues.action: English changed to 'I cannot read fine print.'

issues.jp_before: 駅[えき]で友達[ともだち]に{会[あ]い|nt-homophone}ました。
issues.problem: Distractor 逢い is an accepted (non-jōyō) way to write 'meet', so it is not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced 逢い with the look-alike 全い.
